education.details: Fairleigh S. Dickinson, Jr. Global Manager Award

bullets: Led 40+ discovery conversations with C-suite prospects as the first commercial hire, defining customer profiles and use cases that shaped content and product roadmaps.
Wrote targeted outbound messaging frameworks and localized content, lifting outbound engagement rates to 25%+.
Built SQL and Tableau dashboards to identify lead-to-demo funnel friction and inform segmentation, contributing to a 30% improvement in lead-to-demo conversion.
Designed a stage-based user-activation roadmap with triggered email sequences and ran sequence tests to improve activation.

Owned solution-track campaigns end to end by product line and region across 50+ countries (LinkedIn sponsored content, Eloqua email), including campaign design, metrics, and guardrails; increased marketing-qualified leads 28%.
Equipped 50+ account executives with messaging playbooks, first-call decks, and competitive talking points, reducing campaign execution timelines by 15%.

Partnered with account-based marketing teams on campaigns targeting named banks across North America and the Middle East; developed account-specific messaging and reviewed all campaign content for product accuracy.
Developed customer success stories for banking clients, coordinating stakeholder and legal approvals before publishing them and repurposing them into social and email content.
Planned and ran Finacle Day, the annual flagship customer event with 5,000+ attendees, end to end, alongside executive roundtables and customer briefings with bank leadership.
Increased content engagement 2.4x using SQL and Tableau to evaluate campaign performance and guide content optimization, including email tests across banners, length, CTA, and form length.
Owned positioning, messaging, and executive narratives for ZIF, an AI-driven IT operations (AIOps) platform, translating technical capabilities into customer use cases and business value.
Delivered 80+ live product demonstrations and led CXO discovery calls as first client touch, influencing software procurement decisions globally.
Coordinated cross-functional product launches with Product and Engineering, defining positioning, messaging, and launch plans.
Directed product benchmarking studies against AIOps alternatives, producing competitive talking points for sales and positioning inputs for product.
Rebuilt the product website and authored technical content (blogs, solution briefs, presentations), growing website engagement 40%.
Wrote customer success stories and case studies for healthcare enterprise clients, turning implementation outcomes into proof points for sales and campaigns.
Grew digital acquisition footprint 200% and secured 50M+ impressions through integrated, multi-channel campaigns.
Generated ~$35K USD through online fundraising campaigns using structured conversion optimization across funnels.
Unified frameworks across marketing, legal, and finance to ensure compliance and streamlined execution.

summaries: Product Marketing Manager with 6+ years across enterprise B2B SaaS, fintech, and AI platforms, and an MBA in Business Analytics and Machine Learning. Proven track record of developing positioning, messaging, go-to-market launches, and sales enablement for technical products sold to enterprise buyers. Skilled at translating complex technology into customer stories and executive-level narratives, and at using performance data to refine what works.

Marketing and analytics professional with 6+ years turning customer, funnel, and campaign data into growth decisions across enterprise B2B SaaS and fintech, backed by a STEM MBA in Business Analytics & Machine Learning. Fluent in SQL, Tableau, and full-funnel analytics, and in translating findings into GTM and content that performs.

Go-to-market and product marketer with 6+ years launching technical B2B SaaS/fintech products to enterprise buyers — positioning, messaging, demand generation, and sales enablement — with the analytics (SQL, Tableau) to prove and refine what works.
